description: This header file defines the SystemDelegate class, which manages system-related information and events in a media device environment. It includes methods for retrieving and setting device info, handling subscriptions to Thunder plugin events, and emitting events for resolution, HDR, HDCP, audio, and device name changes.

classes.name: SystemDelegate
classes.description: A class that manages system information, event subscriptions, and event emissions for a media device, interfacing with Thunder plugins and handling device state changes.

methods.name: GetDeviceMake
methods.description: Retrieves the device manufacturer information via Thunder plugin call.

methods.name: GetDeviceName
methods.description: Retrieves the device friendly name via Thunder plugin call.

methods.name: SetDeviceName
methods.description: Sets the device friendly name via Thunder plugin call.

methods.name: GetDeviceSku
methods.description: Retrieves the device SKU from system version info.

methods.name: GetFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the firmware version, including major, minor, patch, and readable info.

methods.name: GetCountryCode
methods.description: Retrieves the country/territory code derived from Thunder plugin.

methods.name: SetCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country/territory code via Thunder plugin.

methods.name: GetTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone setting.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone.

methods.name: GetSecondScreenFriendlyName
methods.description: Alias for GetDeviceName.

methods.name: GetScreenResolution
methods.description: Gets current screen resolution as [width, height].

methods.name: GetVideoResolution
methods.description: Infers video resolution based on screen resolution, with fallback to 1080p.

methods.name: GetHdcp
methods.description: Retrieves HDCP status and returns flags for HDCP 1.4 and 2.2.

methods.name: GetHdr
methods.description: Retrieves HDR capabilities and returns flags for HDR10, Dolby Vision, HLG, HDR10+.

methods.name: GetAudio
methods.description: Retrieves supported audio formats and sets flags for stereo, Dolby Digital, Dolby Atmos.

methods.name: EmitOnVideoResolutionChanged
methods.description: Emits event when video resolution changes.

methods.name: EmitOnScreenResolutionChanged
methods.description: Emits event when screen resolution changes.

methods.name: EmitOnHdcpChanged
methods.description: Emits event when HDCP status changes.

methods.name: EmitOnHdrChanged
methods.description: Emits event when HDR capabilities change.

methods.name: EmitOnNameChanged
methods.description: Emits event when device name changes.

methods.name: EmitOnAudioChanged
methods.description: Emits event when supported audio formats change.

methods.name: HandleEvent
methods.description: Handles app subscription and unsubscription to device events, managing underlying Thunder subscriptions.
